num_customers: <int> Number of customers whose demands must be fulfilled.
num_plants: <int> Number of candidate plant sites that may be opened.
capacity_tightness_ratio: <int> Ratio of total plant capacity to total customer demand, controlling how tight capacity constraints are.

customers.demands: <list[int], length num_customers> Quantity of goods demanded by each customer.
customers.x_coords: <list[float], length num_customers> Horizontal coordinate of each customer's location.
customers.y_coords: <list[float], length num_customers> Vertical coordinate of each customer's location.

plants.fixed_costs: <list[int], length num_plants> Fixed cost incurred for opening each candidate plant.
plants.capacities: <list[float], length num_plants> Maximum total demand each plant can serve if opened.
plants.x_coords: <list[float], length num_plants> Horizontal coordinate of each candidate plant's location.
plants.y_coords: <list[float], length num_plants> Vertical coordinate of each candidate plant's location.

shipping_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][num_plants]> Cost of supplying a customer's entire demand from a given plant, proportional to demand and Euclidean distance.
